contentSyncTriggers: CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_job_search_BEFORE_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON `job_applications` BEGIN DELETE FROM `job_search` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END
